title: Intergroup Dialogue Facilitator Development & Practicum
description:
Restriction: Permission of the Counseling, Higher Education, and Special Education department.
Cross-listed with: CPSP300, HONR300.
Credit only granted for: WEID300, CPSP300, HONR300, or EDDI300.
Formerly: WEID300.
Additional information: Students must be given permission to enroll and be admitted to the intergroup dialogue facilitator program.
